title: Handoff source coverage completion
summary: This iteration completed the repository-local part of the previous handoff plan by adding RSSHub-ready platform source slots, guarding existing official GitHub organization Atom feeds, and making HTML index discovery parse recent candidates from structured JSON-LD metadata when visible anchor blocks do not carry title/date text.

lessons.lesson: RSSHub-dependent sources should be explicit in the registry even before infrastructure exists.
lessons.evidence: The new platform route entries remain manual and skipped until a base URL is configured, so validation can prove the intended routes without making publish depend on unavailable infrastructure.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep platform routes gated and document the external infrastructure requirement separately from repository-local source contracts.

lessons.lesson: HTML indexes can expose article links while hiding dates and headlines in JSON-LD metadata.
lessons.evidence: The focused test reproduced an Anthropic-style index where the anchor text was only a generic call to action. JSON-LD now supplies title, date, and summary for the matched URL.
lessons.recommended_action: Prefer URL-keyed structured metadata as a fallback, while still requiring the configured link pattern to match before admitting a candidate.

followups.action: After a real RSSHub base URL is available, replace placeholder route segments with reviewed production routes and run a daily discovery dry run.
Use the next scheduled run to verify that source_effectiveness shows candidate_created for the newly productive source classes.
